title: Wave-staggered kinetic list
blurb: Composites five live drawable HTML list rows inside one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas, cascading damped harmonic springs with velocity skew, directional blur and R/B chroma separation across filtering, shuffling and flick-scrolling.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas cascade staggered damped harmonic springs across five live drawable HTML list rows with velocity skew, directional blur and R/B chroma separation during filtering, shuffling and flick-scrolling while locking button hit testing 1:1 at rest?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160.0.8188.0 canary (2026-11-27, 412x915 at 2.625 DPR and 1024x900 at 1 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass (937x941 px, 0.88 MP, 7.05 MB on one ElementGL context, 0 lost contexts, 0 open snapshots), t = 120 ms shows row 0 settled (0.0 px remaining) ahead of row 4 lagging (51.2 px remaining, skew 0.013), peak shear and R/B chroma produce maxRB = 223 vs 0 at rest, updateElementGeometry() routes clicks accurately across shuffled rows, and #plain-host fallback activates cleanly. Chrome 159 on Android and npm run check:jank stay not verified.
